name: Healthcare Science
tagline: Get a hands-on start toward a career in healthcare.
description: The Healthcare Science pathway introduces students to the medical field through anatomy, patient care, and clinical skills. Students can work toward industry certifications and clinical experience before graduating.

courses.title: Introduction to Healthcare Science
courses.desc: Foundational course covering the healthcare industry and career paths.

courses.title: Essentials of Healthcare
courses.desc: Anatomy & physiology basics and foundational patient-care skills.

courses.title: Applications of Therapeutic Services
courses.desc: Applied clinical skills preparing students for certification.

courses.title: Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA)
courses.desc: State certification coursework and clinical hours.

courses.title: Clinical Work-Based Learning
courses.desc: Supervised clinical placement with a local healthcare employer.
